leave.title: Leave the couple
leave.lead: You stop seeing and receiving what belongs to the couple. You can create another couple or join with an invite later.
leave.keep: What was shared stays with the person who remains: the couple's notes and blocks, open tasks and the shopping list.
leave.takes: What was only yours goes with you and reaches a next couple always as private.
leave.cancels: Pending reminders between you two are canceled, and unused invites stop working.
leave.financeSettle: Any open balance is recorded as a leaving settlement. Your personal expenses and income go with you.
leave.download: Download a copy of your data
leave.downloadGoals: Download a copy of your goals
